description: R08 host AliasTests checkpoint: safe Rust owns DOSKEY alias lookup and macro expansion, including positional/all-argument macros, redirection/control escapes, CRLF accounting and all negative-match paths. The five source contracts are Exact.

entries.notes: AliasStore reproduces Microsoft's full data-driven DOSKEY expansion matrix: $1..$9, $*, $l/$g/$b/$t case-insensitively, unknown-dollar passthrough, preserved argument spacing, trailing CRLF and line accounting.
An empty/unregistered executable identity yields no expansion and therefore leaves caller line state untouched.
An executable with no alias table yields no expansion.
A populated executable table with a different alias yields no expansion.
Leading whitespace prevents alias tokenization exactly as the native host compatibility path requires.
